As of v2.5.6, a query string with a malformed percent escape no longer throws a `URIError`. A `%` that starts no escape is kept as written, and escapes that do not form valid UTF-8 decode to U+FFFD, as the WHATWG URL Standard specifies. The same applies to the query string of a `URL`, which `url.searchParams` parses.
